q: We buy hot rolled coil from a Dolvi steel works. What figure should we use for Scope 3?
title: Dolvi steel coil in a buyer's Scope 3
short: Ask the mill for a product-specific figure per tonne of coil, with its method and boundary, and use it times tonnes bought. Without one, use a published average for the route, labelled. Integrated plants can run more than one ironmaking route, so a figure for the exact product beats a company average.
audience: Indian and EU buyers of coil from the Dolvi steel cluster

ul: CO2e per tonne for the grade and product you buy.
Whether it is cradle to gate and includes electricity.

p: A CBAM figure for coil counts direct emissions and precursors only. A Scope 3 or product footprint figure includes electricity, so it is usually higher. Do not mix them.
Use a sector average such as worldsteel's for the likely route and say so. Replace it when the mill responds.

senseible: Senseible reads your fuel, electricity and purchase documents into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its source.
